STONE CODEX

Collected notes of the Helix Institute on the ten Power Stones.

Socket stones into the Stone Gauntlet. Slots open at Total Power 200 / 1000 / 3000 / 6000 / 10000.

FIRE STONE
Passive: immune to fire and lava.
Active: ring of flames around you.
Found: Volcano Station, Lava Forge (Lava Golem).

FROST STONE
Passive: hits slow enemies.
Active: frost burst freezes the area.
Found: Cryo Vault, Frozen Ship, Frost Giant.

STORM STONE
Passive: +8% speed.
Active: calls lightning on the target.
Found: Weather Station (Storm Lord), Core Chamber.

NATURE STONE
Passive: slow health regeneration.
Active: vine trap holds zombies.
Found: Swamp Hut, Jungle Ruins, Hive Nest.

BLOOD STONE
Passive: hits steal health.
Active: blood storm, area damage.
Found: Patient Zero (Outbreak Lab), Quarantine City.

SHADOW STONE
Passive: at night zombies notice you late.
Active: short invisibility.
Found: Shadow Ruins (Shadow Stalker).

SOUL STONE
Passive: keep your inventory on death.
Active: summons spirit soldiers.
Found: Ancient Underground City (Forgotten King).

TIME STONE
Passive: cooldowns -10%.
Active: slows time for 5 s.
Found: Lost Library (Time Keeper), Crystal Cavern.

VOID STONE
Passive: longer teleport range.
Active: mini black hole.
Found: Core Chamber (Core Warden).

EARTH STONE
Passive: no knockback.
Active: ground quake.
Found: Crystal Cavern, Buried Pyramid.

COMBOS
Fire+Storm: plasma blast
Frost+Void: absolute zero
Blood+Shadow: vampire
Time+Soul: rebirth
Nature+Earth: forest fortress
